subject: Are typeof , mode and class the same?

messages.author: 0d38e3e78fac7fee
messages.subject: Are typeof , mode and class the same?
parts:
Hi, 

Are they different between "class", "typeof" and "mode" in R? I found they are a little bit difference, but don't know  what differences in them? (Please refer to below cases)

Does anyone know the answer?


CASE 1:
> x <- 1:3
> x
[1] 1 2 3
> class(x)
[1] "integer"
> typeof(x)
[1] "integer"
> mode(x)
[1] "numeric"

CASE 2:
> class(iris)
[1] "data.frame"
> typeof(iris)
[1] "list"
> mode(iris)
[1] "list"
>
